The relocation of Grande Avenue would require 90 feet of additional right of way to restore access to abutting properties.
Construction of additional traffic lanes and concrete median barrier safety section on existing I-94 from the Ariport Spur to Layton Avenue will also be provided. The typical I-94 reconstruction section is shown in figure 8%.
All lands acquired by the proposed facility which are not needed for actual construction of the pavement will be landscaped to provide a primary ground cover. After the roadway work is completed additional landscaping contracts will be implemented to establish shrubs and trees.
